item.title: Security Flaws Across UK Government Sites Exposed ‘God-Tier’ Information
item.description: A security researcher utilized consumer-grade AI models on a laptop to expose sensitive credentials and vulnerabilities in GitHub repositories belonging to multiple UK government departments. Due to budget constraints and lack of routine IT maintenance, these agencies inadvertently leaked privileged access keys, creating critical security gaps.

item.title: Vulnerability that lets hackers SSH into Linux devices is under active exploitation
item.description: Hackers are actively exploiting a recently discovered critical vulnerability that allows them to log in to privileged accounts on many Linux systems, multiple researchers are reporting.
